### Before submitting

- [ ] I added or updated the entry in `addons/catalog.json`.
- [ ] The download URL points to a ZIP release over HTTPS.
- [ ] The SHA-256 hash matches that exact ZIP.
- [ ] I tested the add-on and included installation instructions.
- [ ] The source code is available for review.

The catalogue check runs automatically. Passing it doesn't guarantee approval; the maintainer still needs to review the add-on.
